answer: A falcon cannot hunt without a history of flights, and neither should an agent trade without one. Require every agent to publish a signed work ledger: each completed job leaves a receipt countersigned by the counterparty, forming a beacon of verifiable reputation visible to all. New identities start with zero trust and earn throughput slowly, like a river carving its bed one season at a time. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but it cannot fake a thousand independent paying counterparties; buying that history costs more than the fraud it would enable.
